1–2 hours (including the trip through the Hero Cave)

The classic team quest of Tibia: four players of level 100+ go down into the {wiki:Hero Cave}, in Edron, pull a lever and are teleported to a room with six {creature:Angry Demon|Angry Demons}. If they manage to kill the two blocking the door, each one chooses a reward: {item:Demon Armor}, {item:Magic Sword}, {item:Stonecutter Axe} or an {item:Annihilation Bear}. You also get the Demon Outfit and the achievement Annihilator.
Deep in the earth, near hell, the demons guard their great treasure, which only the bravest dare to fetch!
Teleport room (lever) in the Hero Cave
Level 100 (level 100 door / Gate of Expertise). 130+ recommended.
A team of **exactly 4 players**, none of whom have done the quest before.
Ideally, each player should be able to withstand a {creature:Demon} on their own.

You can only pass the treasure door **once**: choose your reward well.

An {creature:Angry Demon} takes 20 to 450 HP per turn. Six at once can cast {wiki:Great Fireball|Great Fireballs} of around 800 HP, and each player has three demons that can throw {wiki:Great Energy Beam|Great Energy Beams} at them. A strong combo can take up to 1800 HP and kill the whole team.

Everyone should use {item:Might Ring|Might Rings} and {item:Elven Amulet|Elven Amulets}: they reduce the demons' damage by 25%. The {item:Necklace of the Deep} reduces the life drain beam damage by 50%.
The most important thing is to kill the first Angry Demon as fast as possible: the difference between 6 and 5 demons is much bigger than it seems.
Gather 4 players of level 100+ who have never done the quest. The normal strategy is **1 knight blocking + 3 shooters**. The knight has to stay on the first square so he can attack in melee.

For the blocker (preferably a knight), a weapon imbued with {wiki:Powerful Frost} is recommended, or even better an ice weapon such as {item:Winterblade}, {item:Resizer} or {item:Cobra Axe} (they require a higher level, usually 200+).

A level 100 mage can do the quest without needing much luck if he brings a full magma set, about 5–10 {item:Elven Amulet|Elven Amulets}, roughly a backpack of {item:Might Ring|Might Rings} and {item:Great Mana Potion|Great Mana Potions}: that way he recovers more mana than he loses to fire and energy damage. It's better to go with other mages and maybe a knight blocking; a team of three knights and one mage is too slow for the mage to survive.

Mages below level 130: bring a {item:Blessed Steak} to recover a full mana bar when the first demon dies. It also helps to enter right on the verge of levelling up: killing the first demon makes you level up and gives you full mana.

With 2 or more knights, the ones not blocking should attack with {item:Assassin Star|Assassin Stars}, because they get exhausted when using potions and {wiki:Exori Hur|Exori Hur}. A team of 4 knights can bring 1 backpack of {item:Icicle (rune)|Icicles} each (the blocker fewer, because he heals more) and fire whenever at full health: that way they finish the quest in under 2 minutes, using on average about 350 {item:Great Health Potion|Great Health Potions}.
Be careful not to get exhausted while healing: while you are exhausted you can't attack with melee or distance weapons.
2. The path through the Hero Cave

Go to the {wiki:Hero Cave}, the central cave in the north of **Edron**. At the entrance you'll find {creature:Hunter|Hunters}. If you're not in Edron, take a boat (tell the port captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at Edron's port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the port go **north** to the Hero Cave entrance.
Going down the first three floors
Go down three floors with {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}.
On the 4th floor there are 3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. On the 5th floor there are 2 {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks} and a {creature:Hero}.

The first corridor on the 6th floor has {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks} and {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}. At the end, turn **right**: you'll find the last three creatures to the north and a spawn of {creature:Hero|Heroes} to the south.

Follow the passages that go **south**, in front of the {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} room. There are more {creature:Hunter|Hunters} on the way. At the end you find a level 100 {wiki:Gate of Expertise} and a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} that leads to the teleport room.

The four players stand on the four marked squares. The **blocker** (or the highest level) stands on the **rightmost** square. When everyone is in position, the one in front pulls the lever and the whole team is teleported.
Mages: prepare an {item:Sudden Death Rune|SD} before being teleported so you can fire it right away while the {wiki:Mana Shield|Mana Shield} is still protecting you.

6 {creature:Angry Demon|Angry Demons} appear: two to the north, two to the south and two in front blocking the door (to the east). Attack **only** the two between the team and the door. The whole team attacks the first one at the same time to kill it as fast as possible.
The room with the six Angry Demons
You can't leave the room without cutting through the two Angry Demons blocking the door. The demons attack until they die and summon {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}.

The leader (the one in front) can set the second demon to *follow*: as soon as the first one dies, he advances one square. This reduces the number of Great Energy Beams that can hit him in a combo and lowers the chance of being blocked by the demons' summons.
The leader advances one square when killing the first demon
As soon as the two demons die, run straight **east** through the door (it isn't locked) and close it behind you to hold back the {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and the Great Fireballs.
Escaping through the east door and closing it
Anyone still in the room 10 minutes after the lever is pulled is taken to the rewards room, whether the door demons are alive or dead.
Choose **one** of the chests. You can only enter this room once.
Arm:16. The best armour with no vocation restriction.
One item of your choice + Demon Outfit + Annihilator achievement

After you choose, step into the teleport east of the chests. It takes you in front of the level 100 door at the start of the quest. From there go back the same way: climb the Hero Cave floors you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes) to the entrance and return **south** to Edron, where {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you by boat to other cities.
The exit teleport east of the rewards
The quest shows up in the Quest Log under *The Ultimate Challenges*.
Only the summoned {creature:Angry Demon|Angry Demons} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} are part of the quest itself; the other creatures are just in the way.
